paper_title: Sparsest Cut and Eigenvalue Multiplicities on Low Degree Abelian Cayley Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Approximation algorithms analysis
Mathematics of computing → Spectra of graphs
statement: ▶ Conjecture 12. Let G = Cay(Γ, S) be a Cayley graph over an Abelian group Γ of size n. There is an algorithm that finds a set Q ⊆ [n], |Q| ⩽ n/2 satisfying ϕG (Q) ⩽ O(ϕ(G)) in time nO(1) .
context: In light of the results above, we conjecture that the class of Abelian Cayley graphs does not contain hard examples for sparsest cut: ▶ Conjecture 12. Let G = Cay(Γ, S) be a Cayley graph over an Abelian group Γ of size n. There is an algorithm that finds a set Q ⊆ [n], |Q| ⩽ n/2 satisfying ϕG (Q) ⩽ O(ϕ(G)) in time nO(1) . 3 Bafna and Minzer [9] informally define a “globally hypercontractive graph” to be one with a succinct and algorithmic characterization of its small non-expanding sets. Our result informally shows that low-degree Abelian Cayley graphs have this property, although the formal definitions do not exactly meet.
